mapper.select: select d.*, (ifnull(a.hot, 0) + ifnull(i.hot, 0)) as hot from department d left join ( select department_id, sum(ifnull(views, 0) + ifnull(likes, 0)) as hot from activity group by department_id ) a on d.id = a.department_id left join ( select department_id, sum(ifnull(views, 0) + ifnull(likes, 0)) as hot from information group by department_id ) i on d.id = i.department_id order by hot desc limit 8
